rules applied: Coordinates are used when the source gives them; otherwise the most precise place named (municipality, then state/province, then country).
Only records stacked on exactly the same fallback point are spread (deterministic, seeded by the record id, under 0.05 degrees); "placed at" says so. Source coordinates are never moved.
Every feature has name, group, source and "placed at". Coordinates rounded to 5 decimals.
Empty strings in the sources are written as null.

entries not placed at a municipality (fi.municipality: Alvorada do Oeste sitUação da terra: Terra Interditada pela Funai reFerência/poVo: Isolados do rio Novo e Cachoeira do rio Pacaa Nova
ATALAIA NA ÁREA DE SAÚDE 437 Vítimas
Xerente (Tocantínia) Local do óbito: Tocantínia Causas: Pneumonia

Alvorada do Oeste Situação da terra: Terra Interditada pela Funai Situação de risco: Com a invasão de suas terras por colonos e fazendeiros, esse grupo indígena isolado está sendo empurrado para dentro da Terra Indígena Uru-euwau-wau. Eles estavam localizados na Serra do Urupá, na Reserva Florestal Urupá. Levantamento da Funai na década de 1990 constatou a presença indígena com muitos tapiris (acampamentos, casas provisórias usadas por índios), o que também foi observado pela Missão do Banco Mundial no contexto do Plano Agropecuário e Florestal do estado de Rondônia (Plana Flora). O avanço dos invasores vai expulsando os índios de seu território tradicional. O tamanho da terra interditada foi diminuído drasticamente pela Funai. Teme-se a desinterdição total e conseqüentemente a expropriação desses índios de suas terras tradicionais. O Ibama tem uma fotografia aérea, de 2005, mostrando uma aldeia desse povo.

notes: Entries were read from the PDF text by column (pdfplumber), in reading order, starting a new entry at each date line or repeated field label. Section and state come from the headings above each block.

Check: most state headings print a count ("ACRE - 3 Casos"); "case count check" on each entry says whether the number of entries read for that block equals the printed count. Where it does not, entries may be split, merged or attributed to the wrong state/section.
Some descriptions carry stray text from pull-quotes or photo captions that sit across both columns.

Only entries with a victim, people, territory, municipality or description field were kept; summary tables (e.g. per-state counts of child mortality, land-regularisation tables) are not per-case and were not read.
No gazetteer of indigenous territories was used: entries without a matched municipality sit at the state (or country) point.

notes on that list: CPT "Conflicts in the Field" 2013-2022 are the full annual books; the per-person tables mapped here are the separate table PDFs in "Reports on Violence in Brazil, 2022", which are the same tables.
ICC Annex II (Patterns of violence against rural land users and defenders) describes cases in prose (massacres, targeted groups, hot spots), not as a table.
FBSP "Mapping of the Violence in the Amazon Region" and "Atlas da Violência 2021" give rates and counts by municipality/state in charts and text, not case lists.
Global Witness reports are narrative; their case data is the CSV already mapped (2012-2022).
Front Line Defenders PDFs are single statements / urgent appeals; the cases they concern are in frontline_cases.geojson where their pages were saved.
The saved web folders also hold other PDFs (Massacres folder: e.g. www.gfbv.ch report-ccca-def.pdf, cptnacional press releases, dpu Conflito_fundiario_001.pdf); none is a per-case table.
